name: BBGI Global Infrastructure S.A.
summary: BBGI Global Infrastructure S.A. is a Guernsey-based investment company that invests in global infrastructure assets. The company focuses on acquiring and managing infrastructure investments, including public-private partnerships (PPPs) and other infrastructure projects, across various sectors such as transport, healthcare, and education. BBGI aims to provide investors with stable, long-term returns from its portfolio of infrastructure assets.
